llms.body:
# Primark

> Primark is an international fashion, beauty and homeware retailer offering affordable, trend-led clothing, footwear, accessories, beauty products and home essentials for women, men, kids and babies.

Explore Primark's latest fashion collections, seasonal trends, everyday essentials, homeware, beauty products and licensed collaborations. Primark's regional websites feature product collections, category pages, style inspiration, buying guides and information about the brand.

Product ranges, prices and availability may vary by country and over time.

## Product Information Feed

Primark provides a machine-readable product feed containing product names, descriptions, prices and other product information where available.

- [Primark Product Feed (JSON)](https://feed-llm.productsup.cloud/80bd5a6e-40e6-41fc-b5ff-e9854f6a1ad0/fcf6ae7d-db50-425c-826b-6f3448d386de/llm-products.json): Product information for discovering and understanding Primark's product ranges.

Product information may change. Refer to the relevant regional product pages for current details.

## Regional Websites

Explore Primark's regional websites for local fashion collections, product categories, prices, trends and inspiration.

- [United Kingdom — English](https://www.primark.com/en-gb)
- [Republic of Ireland — English](https://www.primark.com/en-ie)
- [United States — English](https://www.primark.com/en-us)
- [Spain — Spanish](https://www.primark.com/es-es)
- [France — French](https://www.primark.com/fr-fr)
- [Germany — German](https://www.primark.com/de-de)
- [Italy — Italian](https://www.primark.com/it-it)
- [Austria — German](https://www.primark.com/de-at)
- [Belgium — French](https://www.primark.com/fr-be)
- [Belgium — Dutch](https://www.primark.com/nl-be)
- [Netherlands — Dutch](https://www.primark.com/nl-nl)
- [Poland — Polish](https://www.primark.com/pl-pl)
- [Portugal — Portuguese](https://www.primark.com/pt-pt)
- [Czech Republic — Czech](https://www.primark.com/cs-cz)
- [Romania — Romanian](https://www.primark.com/ro-ro)
- [Slovenia — Slovenian](https://www.primark.com/sl-si)
- [Slovakia — Slovak](https://www.primark.com/sk-sk)
- [Hungary — Hungarian](https://www.primark.com/hu-hu)

## UK Product Categories

Explore popular Primark UK product categories covering clothing, footwear, accessories, luggage, homeware and seasonal collections.

### Women's Clothing and Accessories

- [Women's Pyjama Sets](https://www.primark.com/en-gb/c/women/nightwear-and-lingerie/nightwear-ranges/pyjama-sets): Women's pyjama sets and matching sleepwear.
- [Women's Coats and Jackets](https://www.primark.com/en-gb/c/women/clothing/coats-and-jackets): Women's outerwear, coats and jackets.
- [Women's Bags and Purses](https://www.primark.com/en-gb/c/women/accessories/bags-and-purses): Handbags, shoulder bags, purses and accessories.
- [Women's Co-ords](https://www.primark.com/en-gb/c/women/clothing/co-ords): Coordinated clothing sets and matching outfits.
- [Women's Dresses](https://www.primark.com/en-gb/c/women/clothing/dresses): Dresses for everyday wear, holidays and special occasions.
- [Women's Boots](https://www.primark.com/en-gb/c/women/shoes/boots): Women's boots and seasonal footwear.
- [Women's Swimwear and Beachwear](https://www.primark.com/en-gb/c/women/clothing/swimwear-and-beachwear): Swimwear, beachwear and holiday clothing.
- [Women's Cardigans](https://www.primark.com/en-gb/c/women/clothing/jumpers-and-cardigans/cardigans): Women's cardigans and knitwear.
- [Women's Hats, Gloves and Scarves](https://www.primark.com/en-gb/c/women/accessories/hats-gloves-and-scarves): Seasonal accessories and cold-weather essentials.

### Luggage and Travel

- [Suitcases and Luggage](https://www.primark.com/en-gb/c/home/travel-and-lifestyle/suitcases-and-luggage): Suitcases and travel essentials.
- [Hand Luggage and Cabin Bags](https://www.primark.com/en-gb/c/home/travel-and-lifestyle/suitcases-and-luggage/hand-luggage-and-cabin-bags): Cabin bags and hand luggage.
- [Large Suitcases](https://www.primark.com/en-gb/c/home/travel-and-lifestyle/suitcases-and-luggage/large-suitcases): Large travel cases.
- [IT Luggage](https://www.primark.com/en-gb/c/home/travel-and-lifestyle/suitcases-and-luggage/it-luggage): IT Luggage collection.

### Homeware

- [Blankets and Throws](https://www.primark.com/en-gb/c/home/home-furnishings/blankets-and-throws): Soft furnishings and throws.
- [Towels](https://www.primark.com/en-gb/c/home/bathroom/towels): Bathroom towels.
- [Duvets and Pillows](https://www.primark.com/en-gb/c/home/bedroom/duvets-and-pillows): Bedding essentials.
- [Blankets and Throws — Soft Furnishings](https://www.primark.com/en-gb/c/home/home-furnishings/soft-furnishings-and-bedding/blankets-and-throws): Blankets and throws under soft furnishings.
- [Duvet Covers and Sets](https://www.primark.com/en-gb/c/home/bedroom/duvet-covers-and-sets): Duvet covers and bedding sets.

### Men's Clothing

- [Men's Tops and T-Shirts](https://www.primark.com/en-gb/c/men/clothing/tops-and-t-shirts): Casual tops and T-shirts.
- [Men's Shorts](https://www.primark.com/en-gb/c/men/clothing/shorts): Casual and seasonal shorts.
- [Men's Coats and Jackets](https://www.primark.com/en-gb/c/men/clothing/coats-and-jackets): Outerwear and jackets.
- [Men's Joggers](https://www.primark.com/en-gb/c/men/clothing/joggers): Joggers and casual trousers.
- [Men's Pyjamas](https://www.primark.com/en-gb/c/men/nightwear/pyjamas): Nightwear and pyjamas.

### Kids

- [Girls' Clothing](https://www.primark.com/en-gb/c/kids/girls/girls-clothing): Clothing for girls.
- [Girls' Pyjamas and Nightwear](https://www.primark.com/en-gb/c/kids/girls/girls-nightwear-and-underwear/pyjamas-and-nightwear): Girls' sleepwear.
- [Boys' Pyjamas and Nightwear](https://www.primark.com/en-gb/c/kids/boys/boys-nightwear-and-underwear/pyjamas-and-nightwear): Boys' sleepwear.
- [Girls' Coats and Jackets](https://www.primark.com/en-gb/c/kids/girls/girls-clothing/coats-and-jackets): Girls' outerwear.
- [Boys' Clothing](https://www.primark.com/en-gb/c/kids/boys/boys-clothing): Clothing for boys.

### Baby

- [Baby Girls](https://www.primark.com/en-gb/c/baby/baby-girls): Clothing and essentials for baby girls.
- [Baby Boys](https://www.primark.com/en-gb/c/baby/baby-boys): Clothing and essentials for baby boys.
- [Newborn Baby](https://www.primark.com/en-gb/c/baby/newborn-baby): Newborn clothing and essentials.
- [Babygrows and Sleepsuits](https://www.primark.com/en-gb/c/baby/newborn-baby/babygrows-and-sleepsuits): Newborn sleepsuits and babygrows.
- [Bodysuits and Vests](https://www.primark.com/en-gb/c/baby/newborn-baby/bodysuits-and-vests): Baby bodysuits and vests.

### Collaborations and Licensed Collections

- [Disney Collection](https://www.primark.com/en-gb/c/collabs/disney): Disney-themed clothing, accessories and merchandise.

### Seasonal Christmas Collections

Explore Primark's Christmas fashion collections, including festive clothing, nightwear and matching family outfits.

- [Christmas Jumpers](https://www.primark.com/en-gb/c/christmas/what-to-wear/christmas-clothing/christmas-jumpers): Festive Christmas jumpers and knitwear.
- [Christmas Pyjamas](https://www.primark.com/en-gb/c/christmas/what-to-wear/christmas-nightwear/christmas-pyjamas): Christmas-themed pyjamas and nightwear.
- [Christmas Family Pyjamas](https://www.primark.com/en-gb/c/christmas/what-to-wear/christmas-nightwear/christmas-family-pyjamas): Coordinated festive pyjamas for families.

## Primark Stores, Help and Brand Information

- [Primark UK Homepage](https://www.primark.com/en-gb): Explore Primark's latest fashion, beauty, homeware and seasonal collections.
- [Primark Store Locator](https://www.primark.com/en-gb/stores): Find Primark stores and local store information.
- [Primark Help Centre](https://www.primark.com/help/s/?language=en_GB): Official customer support information covering product enquiries, returns and exchanges, gift cards, store information, product care and frequently asked questions.
- [Primark Corporate Website](https://corporate.primark.com): Learn more about Primark, its business, values and initiatives.

## Additional Information

- Primark's regional websites provide market-specific product collections, prices and content.
- Product ranges, availability and seasonal collections change regularly.
- Category pages provide an overview of product ranges, while individual product pages contain product-specific information.
- The Primark product feed provides supplementary machine-readable product information.
- Refer to the relevant regional website for current product information.
